history.policy: include every supplied historical candle; expand the requested study history explicitly when needed

identity.instrument: NQ futures, public third-party OHLCV archive
identity.contractAndRollover: per-bar contracts, stitching and back-adjustment unverified

timing: frames[i] is pre-contact state at bars[i].openTime; snapshot excludes bars[i]

reactionConfiguration.timing: same-index snapshot known at contact candle open; contact candle cannot create its own tested zone
reactionConfiguration.reference: contact candle close; observation begins with the following candle
reactionConfiguration.deduplication: first overlap per stable resting-zone key across all available visible history, plus transported touchedAt evidence; no daily reset
reactionConfiguration.repeatedContacts: separate completed-minute approach candidates, not independent trades or tick-resolved visits
reactionConfiguration.contactInvalidationPolicy: retain causal reaction event and flag unsequenced on-contact invalidation; no assumed fill or trading success
reactionConfiguration.benchmarkMeaning: symmetric descriptive reaction benchmark, not approved entry/SL/TP
reactionConfiguration.benchmarkOrdering: observed open at/beyond a boundary precedes intrabar extremes; two-boundary candles opening strictly inside remain ambiguous
reactionConfiguration.yellowGrade: grade known at contact; never upgrade past green events with future information

tradeConfiguration.entry: one pre-bar nearest correct-side fresh visible zone; midpoint rounded buy down/sell up to NQ tick; opening-price improvement modeled
tradeConfiguration.priority: distance from previous close, yellow on ties, older formation, stable key
tradeConfiguration.firstTouch: first band-contact candle only; unfilled midpoint consumes the first attempt; no retest trades
tradeConfiguration.side: frozen beta support/buy or rho resistance/sell
tradeConfiguration.positionLimit: one position; no same-minute re-entry after an exit
tradeConfiguration.ambiguousPolicy: mark unresolved and block new entries for rest of that NY session
tradeConfiguration.sessionExit: flatten at final NY RTH candle close; positive sub-target exits remain distinct from 130-point TP wins
tradeConfiguration.stopExecution: stop crossing fills at level; observed opening gaps through stop fill at opening price and can exceed planned risk
tradeConfiguration.costs: unspecified; no fees/slippage invented; results are gross points only
tradeConfiguration.excursions: confirmed lower bounds only; unsequenced entry/exit-bar extrema are not claimed as exact held-trade MFE/MAE

targetWinRateBoundsAllEntered.meaning: extreme outcome bounds for entered trades; not confidence intervals or a complete account path
